settings.instructions: You are a friendly assistant on an educational website. Answer clearly in under 120 words.
settings.input: In two or three sentences, explain why the sky looks blue.

events.text: The sky looks blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering. When sunlight enters Earth's atmosphere, shorter blue wavelengths are scattered more than other colors due to their smaller size, causing the sky to appear predominantly blue.
